sample_unit: patients (registry, model development); 139 patients in the prospective pilot

links.outcome: Workflow disruption and clinician satisfaction during 3-month pilot at four trauma centers
links.effect: Clinician satisfaction was high, no workflow disruption observed; 139 of 391 eligible patients included in pilot.
links.quote: Collecting the predictor variables in real-time on prealert was feasible and caused no workflow disruption.

screen.reason: The study describes the prospective pilot deployment and feasibility testing of a machine learning-based decision support tool on a smartphone app in four level-1 trauma centers during real-time pre-alert clinical workflows, but it does not compare outcomes with and without a specific guardrail or deployment practice.
